Card Q&A.q: My opponent attacks with a Digimon and deletes my only blue Digimon with its [When Attacking] effect. I have no other blue Digimon in play, but can I still block the attack with this Digimon?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a blue Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
